title: Chinese Companies Are Selling Vapes With Chemicals Potentially More Potent Than Nicotine
summary: But after Congress closed that loophole in 2022—expanding regulation beyond tobacco-derived nicotine—Chinese manufactures began filling their vapes with little-studied chemicals that mimic nicotine's effects, known as nicotine analogs. Vapes containing nicotine analogs may also expose users to other mysterious chemicals.
